en.headline: HKTDC Entrepreneur Day opens at Convention Centre with startup showcases
en.dek: The two-day event under the theme Where Start-up Dreams Take Flight runs until Friday with more than 370 exhibitors and free admission for registered visitors.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council's Entrepreneur Day 2026 opened today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

Held in Halls 1D to 1E until 20 November, the event brings together startups, investors, business leaders and aspiring entrepreneurs. Under the theme Where Start-up Dreams Take Flight, it features exhibitions, seminars, pitching sessions and networking, with more than 370 exhibitors expected.
Admission is free for registered trade and public visitors. The programme runs concurrently with the Business of IP Asia Forum and DesignInspire at the same venue.

zh.headline: 香港貿發局創業日於會展開幕展示初創方案
zh.dek: 以「初創夢啟航」為主題的兩日活動至周五舉行，預計逾370家參展商，已登記訪客免費入場。
body: 香港貿易發展局的創業日2026今日於灣仔香港會議展覽中心開幕。
活動在展覽廳1D至1E舉行至11月20日，匯聚初創企業、投資者、商界領袖及有志創業人士。以「初創夢啟航」為主題，設有展覽、研討會、路演及交流活動，預計超過370家參展商。
已登記的業內人士及公眾可免費入場。活動與亞洲知識產權營商論壇及DesignInspire同期於同一場地舉行。
